title: Coast Guard rescues 2 aboard disabled, aground vessel near Galveston, Texas
description: A Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew from Air Station Houston rescues two boaters from a disabled, aground vessel near Galveston, Texas, Oct. 28, 2023. When the 21-foot cuddy cabin ran aground on the North Jetty, the boat’s operator called the Coast Guard for assistance. (U.S. Coast Guard video, courtesy Air Station Houston)
